prompt_text: What is a good martial arts school for kids in St. Peters MO?
answer_verbatim:
A good **martial arts school for kids in St. Peters, MO** is **Gracie Barra St. Peters** if you want Brazilian jiu-jitsu focused kids’ training, and **World Martial Arts Academy** if you want a broader kids’ martial arts program.[2][6]

A few strong options in the area are:

- **Gracie Barra St. Peters** — promotes itself as “the area’s best martial arts for kids,” and the St. Louis Mom guide lists its St. Peters location at **953 Jungermann Road**.[2][6]
- **World Martial Arts Academy** — listed at **1057 Cave Springs Blvd.** and offers kids programs such as **Preschool Karate (ages 4–6)**, **Kids Karate (ages 7–11)**, and **Youth Jiu Jitsu (ages 6–12)**.[1][6]
- **ATA Martial Arts – St. Peters** — located at **6720 Mexico Rd.** and appears to have a solid local presence with public reviews on Facebook.[4][7]
- **All Star Karate** — listed in St. Peters and described as offering karate training, with a kids program page and a free introductory program noted in local listings.[5][6][10]

If you want the **best fit for a kid**, the most useful factors are the child’s age, whether you want **karate vs. jiu-jitsu**, and whether the school offers a trial class or introductory program.[3] If you want, I can narrow this down by **age range, budget, or whether your child wants self-defense, discipline, or competition**.
